title: BillingSettings
description: 1.175.0: the closed values block of one billing_settings_versions row — the thresholds and drivers a provider_owner changes with a record, never a Blueprint knob. The environment (tuning_of(settings)) is the floor; the effective settings at an instant are the latest row with effective_from ≤ now; a period keeps the row it ran under. Every amount is a Decimal string (never a float); cost_drivers values are in the contour's currency; nxc_rate carries its currency and its history is this table. `enforce` is NOT here and never will be — that flag has its own door at S6 with the two record ids quoted; a version carrying it is 422 SETTINGS_FIELD_RESERVED. Prices are never here — a price book is a signed, dual-approved document.

promo_on_create.description: the promo lot (NXC) every new organization receives on organization.created — Decimal string

promo_on_first_connection.description: the promo lot (NXC) on the first healthy organization-owned connection — Decimal string

promo_expiry_days.description: promo lots expire this many days after the grant

reservation_ttl_min.description: a reservation not settled or released within this window is released by the worker

default_ceiling_nxc.description: the estimate's ceiling (NXC) when the Flow's Budget names none — Decimal string

adjustment_dual_approval_above.description: an adjustment or grant above this amount (NXC) needs a second operator's approval — Decimal string

low_balance_thresholds_pct.description: nexus.billing.low_balance.v1 once per (organization · threshold · period) as available credits cross each percentage

cost_drivers.description: the disclosed unit-cost table per contour — {contour: {service_code: unit_cost}}, every value a Decimal string (up to twelve places — a per-ms rate) IN THE CONTOUR'S CURRENCY (the binding's billing account's). Direct cost = Σ rated units × unit_cost; a code the table does not name carries no direct cost.

fixed_weight.description: the capacity weight that spreads the contour's shared-fixed bucket — seats or members; never activity

nxc_rate.description: the NXC → money rate of the margin read model with its currency; a change needs effective_from ≥ now + SETTINGS_RATE_LEAD_HOURS (24) — a rate never moves a day already closed, and the five numbers read the rate effective on the day, never today's

reconciliation_variance_pct.description: |reconciled − estimated| / estimated above this percentage files exactly one operational_issue per (contour · day) — Decimal string

unallocated_org_ids.description: the organizations whose share is the contour's unallocated line (the provider's own organization, QA, CI, subsidised trials); never spread to customers

promo_on_create_max.description: 1.183.0: the most NXC a prepared organization's `credits_on_activation` may grant on organization.created — the lot is min(credits_on_activation, promo_on_create_max); a row that names no credits gets promo_on_create. Decimal string; default 1000

rate.description: money per 1 NXC in `currency`, Decimal string
